Please let me know the reasons for these questions please. 1552 views Q. Dream regarding preparations of marriage 1344 views Q. Assalam o Alaikum Warahmatullahe Wabarakatuhu Mofti sahb, I am in circumstances where I have to take some very important decision. The situation is that I am living in Dubai, UAE with my family. I got married in 2007 and Allah Blessed me with a daughter this year. My wife, daughter and mother all live with me here in Dubai. My father was died long back and I am taking care of my mother. As you know, due to increasing inflation it is very difficult to save some money. I could not save any single dirham for last two years since when I came here in dubai.and also sometime a satuation come that it becomes very difficylt to pass the month in my earning So I am thinking whether to keep my family here with me and keep living without saving any money and just trust on Allah that situation will get better or if I send my family back home (Pakistan), I can save reasonable amount every month. So before making the final decision, I decided to do ''Istikhara'' as sunnah. Yesterday night, I abolute and offered two nawaffil and then recite dua for correct guidance from Allah SWT and then slept without talking to anybody. I saw a dream that I want you to give me ''tabeer'' for. I saw that I am standing by a closed grave which is made of white marble (and I felt in dream that this is my own grave). I am dusting the grave and I am saying to my wife with so much grief that how would you live without me (meaning that when I will go into the grave). That''s it. I don''t know whether this dream is meaningful or not. Or it has any connection with ''Istikhara'' but I simply request you to please guide me on this. Jazakumullaho khair. 1489 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 41367 Country: India Title: I was sitting in a Masjid and this girl Salma was sitting in front of me and as soon as she looked at me she was like shivered of fear Question: I was sitting in a Masjid and this girl Salma was sitting in front of me and as soon as she looked at me she was like shivered of fear, then I came out of Masjid and I see her brother talking to my brother and sister. I did not get a good feeling about her brother (probably as not so nice guy). (2) Where I see a very old building is getting collapsed and a few old cars were there on its roof and the whole building felt to ground. (3) Me and my eldest brother were trying to enter a house a dog came running out of it and tried to bite me, I tried to stop but it was just trying to bite me but not my brother". (4) I was in a house with lots of people and I was looking at a girl who was very beautiful and I liked her very much, but at the same time I see one more girl there very pious and felt like she is actually the girl I am looking in marriage? My brother is against this marriage and I think my family will collapse if I move further with this marriage. Please suggest me. Answer ID: 41367 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1436/L=533/TL=1433) If you are getting this indication in your istikharah that it is not better to marry there then you should preferably not marry there, . In order to get pious wife keep on reading the following dua extensively: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَاماً [الفرقان : 74] Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
